opening.argument: The presentation promotes KCS through a forecast of substantial appreciation and a claimed stream of recurring payments: it is described as likely to “explode,” while viewers are told they are “getting paid every single day” by holding the token. It also directs viewers to an exchange referral link and code, then ties compensation to referred users’ trading activity, including payouts from a referral of a referral. Those claims present token appreciation and daily returns as reasons to participate, while the available material does not establish the bonus terms, any actual payment, or the claimed returns.
